note: The sources below document the public job feed and optional integrations. CodeAtlas does not publish numeric salary estimates or live demand claims in this register.

sources.title: Greenhouse Job Board API
sources.used_for: The job collector reads published listings from configured public Greenhouse boards and links back to the employer's original posting.
sources.limits: Board availability and posting dates vary by employer. A source date can reflect an update, and listings must be verified at the employer site.

sources.title: Lever Postings API
sources.region: Global and EU endpoints, depending on employer board
sources.used_for: The job collector reads published postings from configured public Lever boards.
sources.limits: Only configured board identifiers are queried. A job appearing in this directory is not a guarantee that it remains open.

sources.title: Ashby Public Job Posting API
sources.used_for: The job collector reads published postings from configured public Ashby boards.
sources.limits: Missing fields remain unknown rather than being guessed; direct employer posting is authoritative.

sources.title: National Career Service (Government of India)
sources.used_for: A public source for Indian job search, career guidance, skill courses and mentorship information.
sources.limits: CodeAtlas does not claim affiliation with NCS. Verify details on the official government site; do not pay a recruiter to apply.

sources.title: Anthropic model lifecycle documentation
sources.used_for: Checking that the optional server-side counsellor uses an active model identifier.
sources.limits: API use can incur charges. The AI counsellor remains disabled until the site owner configures a server-side key and endpoint.
